title: Disaster Recovery and High Availability

header.html: 3.3 Explain disaster recovery (DR) concepts: DR metrics (RPO, RTO, MTTR, MTBF); DR sites (cold, warm, hot); high-availability approaches (active-active, active-passive); testing (tabletop exercises, validation tests)
the official CompTIA Network+ N10-009 exam objectives, version 4.0

html:
1DR metrics

Metric Meaning
RPO (recovery point objective) How much data loss is acceptable, measured in time before the disaster (RPO of 4 hours = backups at least every 4 hours)
RTO (recovery time objective) How long the service may be down before it must be restored
MTTR (mean time to repair) Average time to fix a failed component
MTBF (mean time between failures) Average time a component runs before it fails (reliability)
Exam tip

. RPO looks backward (data lost). RTO looks forward (time to recover). MTTR is repair time; MTBF is time between failures.

2DR sites

Site State Recovery time Cost
Cold site Space and power only; no equipment or data Longest (days to weeks) Lowest
Warm site Equipment installed, data not current (restore from backup) Hours to days Medium
Hot site Fully equipped and running with near real-time data Minutes or seconds Highest

3High availability

Approach Behavior
Active-active All nodes serve traffic at once; load shared; if one fails, the others absorb its load
Active-passive One node serves; a standby waits and takes over on failure (failover)

HA reduces single points of failure: redundant power, links, devices (FHRP, link aggregation, clusters).

4Testing

Test Meaning
Tabletop exercise Staff talk through a disaster scenario step by step, no systems touched
Validation test Actually restore or fail over to prove the plan works
Exam tip

. "Walk through the plan in a meeting" = tabletop exercise. "Prove the backups restore" = validation test.

Exam tip

. Cold < warm < hot for cost and speed. A hot site is running with current data.

5Exam Q&A

5.1 Practice questions (choose the best answer)

S1A company can accept losing at most 2 hours of data. Which metric states this?

  • AAn RTO of 2 hours
  • BAn MTBF of 2 hours
  • CAn RPO of 2 hours
  • DAn MTTR of 2 hours
Show the answer

Answer: C. RPO is the acceptable amount of data loss measured in time.

S2A service must be restored within 30 minutes of an outage. Which metric states this?

  • AAn RPO of 30 minutes
  • BAn RTO of 30 minutes
  • CAn MTBF of 30 minutes
  • DA baseline of 30 minutes
Show the answer

Answer: B. RTO is the maximum acceptable downtime.

S3A company wants a recovery site with equipment ready and near real-time data for the fastest recovery. Which site fits?

  • AA warm site
  • BA cold site
  • CA mobile site without equipment
  • DA hot site
Show the answer

Answer: D. Hot sites are fully equipped and current.

S4Which site type provides only space and power with no equipment installed?

  • AA warm site
  • BA hot site
  • CA cloud region
  • DA cold site
Show the answer

Answer: D. Cold sites are empty shells.

S5Two firewalls both pass traffic and share the load, and one absorbs everything if the other fails. Which approach is this?

  • AActive-active
  • BActive-passive
  • CCold standby
  • DTabletop
Show the answer

Answer: A. In active-active all nodes serve traffic.

S6Management wants staff to discuss a ransomware scenario around a table without touching systems. What is this?

  • AA validation test
  • BA failover test
  • CA tabletop exercise
  • DA penetration test
Show the answer

Answer: C. Tabletop exercises are discussion-based.

5.2 Recall questions

R1What does RPO measure?

Show the answer

Acceptable data loss, in time.

R2What does MTBF measure?

Show the answer

Average time between failures.

R3Which DR site is the cheapest?

Show the answer

A cold site.

R4What happens in active-passive?

Show the answer

A standby node takes over when the active node fails.

R5What is a validation test?

Show the answer

Actually restoring or failing over to prove the plan works.

R6What does MTTR measure?

Show the answer

Average time to repair a failed component.

6Quick Reference Card

Topic Key fact
Metrics RPO (data loss), RTO (downtime), MTTR (repair), MTBF (between failures)
Sites cold (shell), warm (equipment, old data), hot (running, current)
HA active-active (shared), active-passive (standby)
Testing tabletop (discussion), validation (real restore)
